title: Dual-mode UX: Guided video vs Solo timer per exercise
description:
## Summary
Two practice modes per exercise so beginners get video guidance while advanced users get a clean timer.

## Guided Mode (default for new users)
- Embedded video plays inline (YouTube/Facebook via WebView)
- Timer runs alongside but secondary — video IS the guide
- Great for learning movements/technique

## Solo Practice Mode (for returning users)
- No video — just breathing animation orb + timer
- Optional step cues (text prompts: 'Inhale... Hold... Exhale...' timed to practice rhythm)
- Clean, distraction-free
- Small 'Watch video' link for refresher

## UX Details
- Toggle at top of session detail: 'Guided' | 'Solo'
- App remembers preference per exercise (AsyncStorage)
- After completing exercise 3+ times, auto-default to Solo

## Data Model
Add optional timing steps to Exercise:
```typescript
steps?: { label: string; durationSec: number }[]
```

title: Mindful interruption: detect overwork and suggest breathing breaks
description: Detect when user is in a deep work zone and skillfully interrupt with a breathing break suggestion. Tiers: (1) Simple interval timer + expo-notifications push after 90min, (2) Accelerometer stillness detection via expo-sensors, (3) HealthKit heart rate from Apple Watch, (4) Screen Time API (hardest). MVP is timer-based, aligned with ultradian rhythm science (90-120 min cycles). Breathwrk-style gentle nudge: 'You've been going for 2 hours. 3-minute breathing break?' with snooze option.
